prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas. Injury: neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1253; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving through the intersection on a green light when a vehicle coming from my left ran its red and struck the driver's side of my car. The impact pushed my vehicle sideways and I felt my head snap forward and back against the seat. I stopped right away, checked on my passenger, and waited for the police to arrive. I have given the same description of what happened to the other driver, the officer, and the adjuster, and I have not changed any detail. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating the vehicle with permission and in the normal course of my day. Since the collision I have been treated for a neck strain, with stiffness and soreness that limit how far I can turn my head. I am providing this statement so the claim can be reviewed accurately.
